top_reviews.title: Unique design
top_reviews.body: Oh, it’s a great refrigerator. Just kinda hard to get used to having a chest freezer on the bottom. I’m so used to having organized shelves with a side-by-side. It’s taking a little time to get used to the shelf idea having one big shelf on the top and a chest freezer in the bottom but other than that, it’s a great refrigerator. I like having the water dispenser inside.

top_reviews.title: Buy ELSEWHERE
top_reviews.body: Do NOT purchase through Amazon. Their delivery crew refused to deliver it and then took their time refunding my money. Purchased through BBuy and it was delivered without a hitch. The refrigerator is BEAUTIFUL. Works well. Looks GREAT, and I purchased the black doors to make it even nicer.

top_reviews.title: Want to love BUT.....
top_reviews.body: Want to adore this fridge. We saw it at a large box store but delivery exceeded what we wanted to spend. Decided to use Amazon. Main issue is the ice maker. The top freezer frosty up alot and the ice tray for small cubes just stops working . Have to reset and mess with it. Currently it's not working. We got this fridge about 4 weeks ago. Worried this may end up being an ongoing issue.

top_reviews.title: Great addition to your kitchen
top_reviews.body: We absolutely love this refrigerator. The beverage center with the pitcher of water that automatically refills and the shelves for soda cans is an amazing feature. We really like that we can open the door for drinks without having to open the whole refrigerator. The two different types of ice is really nice as well. And the produce drawer is super convenient. I highly recommend this refrigerator, you will not be disappointed.

top_reviews.title: I am in love with my salad bar drawer!
top_reviews.body: For my birthday this year I bought myself a new fridge. I wanted all the bells and whistles and I really wanted a salad bar drawer. I am in love. Size wise this fridge is smaller than our old side by side but the layout allows for way more food storage. We are 100% happy.

top_reviews.title: I can’t believe that this is legal
top_reviews.body: Do not buy this product. I have one. Sure, it’s cool looking but your bottom shelf will ultimately look like this, and this was from someone spilling a green cranberry tea. Normally not a big deal. But when you try to clean it, you will realize you can’t. UNLESS you have the strength of a construction worker. There are videos on how hard it is to clean this subpar appliance. I have tried for days to push the tabs in. This should be illegal. It is uncleanable unless you are super strong. No one over 60 will ever be able to do it. Try it yourself at the store.

top_reviews.title: My dream fridge!
top_reviews.body: I have this fridge from Home Depot for 3 years! It is amazing! I have no ice-maker issues at all! In fact, whenever I take out ice from the tray, it almost immediately dispenses more ice into it. It is so roomy and so well thought out!

top_reviews.title: Refill pitcher
top_reviews.body: I have had this fridge for almost 2 1/2 years. Bought through Lowe’s on sale for $2,800 It is generally a fine fridge, EXCEPT the refill pitcher. This was my favorite feature. About 2 weeks out from the warranty period ( 2 years) it started not refilling the pitcher. It worked randomly for a couple months, then completely pooped out. I had a Samsung service tech come out (that was a fiasco in itself with a no show/call that I restructured my day around and hours spent mostly on hold just talk to someone to schedule.) in which they charged me $120 just to diagnose. He guessed it needed a completely new part that would cost me $470 to replace. If that didn’t work, they would just keep replacing parts until it worked… all at my expense. All this with only a 90 day guarantee that it would work. I paid him his $120 and said no thanks. The fridge LOOKS nice. (Even my teenage daughters friends that hang out think it’s the coolest fridge) but I couldn’t recommend it to anyone for these reasons. Maybe American made appliances would be better…

top_reviews.title: NO ICE FOR YOU!
top_reviews.body: If you’re looking for a refrigerator that pretends to have an ice maker, congratulations—you’ve found your soulmate. I bought this fridge thinking I was stepping into the luxurious world of automatically chilled beverages. Instead, I entered a never-ending tragic comedy titled: “Frozen Expectations: The Ice Maker Chronicles.” Our ice maker has broken five times. Not once, not twice—five. Like a clingy ex, it keeps coming back just long enough to remind me why I hate it. Each time, I had to take off work, wait around for a technician, and listen to them confidently declare, “All fixed!” only to watch it die again like a soap opera character with a flair for dramatic exits. Let’s do the math: • Ice? Minimal. • Missed work? Five times. • Emotional damage? Ongoing. • Trust in Samsung? Zero At this point, I’ve formed a deeper relationship with my ice cube trays than this “state-of-the-art” appliance. They don’t let me down. They don’t require service calls. And they don’t ghost me after three cubes. How many people have broken Samsung ice makers? So many, there was a class action lawsuit. (Google it) Save yourself the heartache. Unless you’re into disappointment, warm drinks, and unpaid time off, steer clear of Samsung. This fridge doesn’t make ice—it makes memories you’ll need therapy for.

top_reviews.body: This Samsung refrigerator has been a disappointment since it came through the door. At the appliance store yesterday the salesman mentioned the bad reputation Samsung has received because of it's ice makers and I stopped him and said YES, I've had to replace the ice maker twice on this refrigerator and now the compressor has gone out and it is only 7 years old now. Rather than dump more money into this pit of a refrigerator I had decided to buy a new LG. He agreed with me about the poor quality of Samsung and said he would never buy one. The whole experience with Samsung has been very poor from customer service to build quality of the device. Bottom line, I won't buy anything from Samsung again.
